description: This source file implements a benchmarking system for a client-server RPC framework, including service and client classes, message handling, thread management, and statistical analysis of performance metrics.

classes.name: SchedStats
classes.description: Tracks scheduler statistics for a thread, including CPU time, wait time, and timeslices, with update functionality reading from procfs.

classes.name: BenchmarkService
classes.description: Implements the server-side of the benchmarking RPC, handling various message types and maintaining per-thread scheduler stats.

classes.name: BenchmarkClient
classes.description: Implements the client-side interface for sending benchmark RPCs, including operations like Nop, Read, Write, Echo, and Stats.

methods.name: GetServicePath
methods.description: Constructs a service path string based on a base path and instance ID.

methods.name: SetThreadName
methods.description: Sets the thread name for debugging purposes.

methods.name: GetClockNs
methods.description: Returns the current monotonic clock time in nanoseconds.

methods.name: ParseOpcodeOption
methods.description: Parses command line argument to set the operation mode for the benchmark.

methods.name: ServiceCommand
methods.description: Creates and runs server instances of the benchmark service, managing dispatch threads.

methods.name: ClientCommand
methods.description: Creates client threads to perform benchmark operations and collects performance metrics.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command line arguments and starts either server or client benchmarking based on user input.
